result.rationale: The diff shows handleNewBooking builds an array of team destination calendars for COLLECTIVE events (teamDestinationCalendars pushed into evt.destinationCalendar), but confirm.handler.ts and the payment webhooks reconstruct evt with only `booking.destinationCalendar ? [booking.destinationCalendar] : [user.destinationCalendar]`. Additionally, handleNewBooking only persists `evt.destinationCalendar[0]` via `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`, so the other hosts' calendars are not stored and are lost when calendar creation is deferred to confirmation/payment. The mechanism is verifia
